output.review_comment:
The code changes correctly make all tests pass, but the docstring is now inaccurate and contradicts the implementation. The docstring states the resulting line must be "at most width characters long" (≤ width), but the code implements < width behavior. This was explicitly done to satisfy test_meeting_reminder and is undocumented. 

Please update the docstring to accurately describe the < width behavior (e.g., "strictly less than width characters" or "fewer than width characters"). Alternatively, add an inline code comment explaining why < is used instead of ≤. Since the tests encode the agreed spec, the documentation should match the specification.
